name: Store and return the normalized display name
reason: The task explicitly requires normalization before storage, actual record update and returning the stored value.

action.explanation: The behavior requires proving actual stored mutation and equality to the normalized response. The available single-request assertions cannot compare caller-owned state before/after; GET following PATCH would be a workflow. No supported rule constructs a padded nonblank input.

name: Reject invalid names without changing the stored name
reason: The task explicitly pairs invalid-input rejection with preservation of the stored name.

action.explanation: Rejection and preservation of the prior stored name must both be checked. The latter needs state comparison or a trusted behavior-specific check, neither representable here; rejection alone would weaken this scenario.

name: Preserve unrelated profile fields
reason: The task directly requires preservation of the profile's other fields.

action.explanation: Preserving every other existing profile field needs a baseline and post-update state comparison. No workflow or arbitrary dictionary equality capability is available; a response field alone cannot establish preservation.

name: Accept free-form nonblank display labels
reason: The task explicitly distinguishes free-form display labels from account identifiers and disclaims these restrictions.

constraint.quote:
display_name is arbitrary nonblank
text, with no format, enum, identity or uniqueness requirement.
